name: Four-week grocery tracker
audience: Households who want a food number before they set the rest of the budget.
summary: Price a repeating grocery list and see the cost per person across four weeks.
description: Enter the aisle, the usual quantity, and the price you last paid. The workbook extends one shop across four weeks and divides the month by the number of people eating.
benefits: Build a list from prices you have actually paid
See a four-week cost without retyping the list
Divide the basket by the number of people
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
